versions.note: First release: TAF Timeline v1.25 (left, 66 %) and LOOME Night Ops v1.7 (right, 34 %) merged into one page, each scoped to its own pane; tabs below 1100 px; installable and offline; WeatherDashboard icon.
LOOME side updated to v1.8 (nearest large or medium airport within 10 NM names the place). TAF unchanged (v1.25).
Top bar with a light/dark switch (opens in dark, remembers the choice); high-legibility light theme for both sides; TAF airport cards always one per row. TAF v1.25 and LOOME v1.8 unchanged.

New Vessels section (v1.0): search the curated vessel list by name or MMSI, view photos from the ais-photos repo, and upload new photos (resized on the device, credit required, shared upload code) via /api/vessel-photo. Own tab below 1100 px, below the TAF timeline on wide screens. TAF v1.25 and LOOME v1.8 unchanged.

Light theme: petrol accent (#27535C) replaces brown across TAF, LOOME and Vessels (titles, labels, selected mode, AIP warning); amber fills unchanged. Selected mode frame follows the switch's rounded corners (both themes). Vessels v1.1: space below the section, search field scrolls to the top when used, full-screen photo viewer (wheel/pinch zoom, drag, double-click/tap reset, Esc/✕ to close).

Version number in the header (LOOME footer line removed). TAF Timeline v1.26: Edit aerodromes has ✕ to remove (with Undo) and the add/search field. Vessels v1.2: MMSI required only for vessels without one, Find MMSI from AIS with picker, MMSI format check (2–7 + 8 digits), hard stop on name/MMSI mismatch with Use AIS name, Upload anyway when MMSI not in AIS, no duplicate MMSIs, Add as separate / Go to existing for same name, vessel type in results. Requires api/vessel-photo.js v1.1.

Vessels v1.3: live traffic map (OpenStreetMap + OpenSeaMap, coloured ship icons rotated to course, grey 5 px vectors and turn curves, layer panel with categories and overlays, tap a vessel for details and photos). Vessel card shows position age, SOG/COG, destination and ETA, plus a mini-map that expands to the full map. Wide screens: Vessels is full width below TAF and LOOME (the page scrolls down to it); phones keep the Vessels tab, with the map opening full screen. Requires AIS Worker 1.5 (/live.json).

Vessels v1.4: opening a vessel in the search (tap, or Enter with one match) centres the live map on it, rings it and opens its info box (full-screen map on phones). Vessels without an MMSI are looked up by exact name in AIS for position and map focus. Info box restyled (dark, readable; light theme supported). Requires AIS Worker 1.7 (/live.json?name=).

Wide screens scroll as one page (fixes iPad scrolling). 'Vessels ↓' button next to the flight-rules switch. Vessels v1.5: heading 'Vessel Information'; map refresh every 30 s; ship icons drawn on canvas from zoom 7; vessel names + speed from zoom 9 (switchable); 2 px vectors; Stations layer (dark blue stars with names); ETA to point (dynamic line + ETA label, kept until removed); station ETA for tankers, rigs and heavy-lift (Mongstad → Holmengrå, Sture → Fedje vest, else nearest); Save MMSI for listed vessels found by name in AIS. Requires api/vessel-photo.js with the setMmsi action.

Vessels v1.6: all vessel ETAs (ETA to point, station ETA, AIS ETA) in Norwegian local time, e.g. 15:42 LT, with automatic summer/winter time. Destination → station also by UN/LOCODE: NO MON / Mongstad → Holmengrå, NO STU / Sture → Fedje vest, NO KAR / Kårstø → Skudefjorden, NO MLK / Melkøya → Fruholmen (spaces, hyphens and case ignored).

Vessels v1.7: on phones the search no longer opens the map full screen (the card stays, the map below centres on the vessel); full screen only via Expand or the ⤢ button in the map header. Inline map on phones lets one finger scroll the page (pan in full screen). Info box → list also finds listed vessels without MMSI. Esc cancels a pending ETA point. Bug sweep: phone, iPad portrait/landscape and PC, light and dark.

Vessels v1.8: Aircraft (SAR) layer on the map (MMSI 111…, helicopter symbol rotated to track, name/speed/altitude, no vectors; dashboard only, never ForeFlight). Station pairing reads FROM>TO (also =>, ->, ' - '): arrival port wins, then departure; label says 'to …' or 'from …'. Wide screens: 'Vessel Information' aligned with 'Live Traffic'. Upload hint text updated. Requires AIS Worker 1.8 (&air=1).

Vessels v1.9: one finger pans the map again on phones (inline and full screen); phone page ends at the map's bottom edge (no empty space below); choosing a vessel in the search hides the other results, with '← All results (n)' to go back; new helicopter symbol (navy, white halo, nose on track); ETA to point also for aircraft.

Vessels v1.10: breadcrumbs for the selected target only — one grey 3 px dot per 2 minutes for the last 60 minutes, fading to ~25 % for the oldest, gaps where there are no reports; refreshed every 30 s; removed when the info box closes (which now also clears the selection ring). Requires AIS Worker 1.9 (/track.json).

Vessels v1.11: map memory reduced to stop iOS reloading the page on big zooms — one shared canvas for symbols, vectors and breadcrumbs with 15 % margin (was a new canvas per redraw, 30 %); tiles: keepBuffer 1, no loading during zoom; seamarks off by default on phones (choice remembered). Measured at iPhone size, full screen, 6 zoom steps: canvas peak 33 → 7 MB, tiles held 42 → 21.
Vessels v1.12: aircraft breadcrumbs (MMSI 111…) one dot every 30 s for the last 45 min (±15 s tolerance, gaps where no report); vessels unchanged (2 min / 60 min).

Vessels v1.13: bug fix — after using ETA to point, targets could no longer be selected (the ETA line created a second map canvas on top that swallowed taps; regression from 1.15). Everything is now drawn on the one shared canvas.

Vessels v1.14: selection persists after closing the info box (ring + breadcrumbs keep updating); tap the selected target again to deselect (double taps within 0.4 s ignored); collapsing the card in the list deselects. ETA to point: tap a station (exact station position), a vessel/aircraft (intercept: line to the meeting point, faint line for the target's movement, 'No intercept at current speed' when unsolvable), or open sea. Stations are tappable only while placing an ETA point; the selection does not change while placing.

Vessels v1.15: bug fix — an ETA/intercept from an aircraft showed 'position not available' after zooming so the aircraft left the view (the out-of-view lookup did not ask the Worker for aircraft). Lookup now includes aircraft, and the last known position of every ETA vessel/target is kept so labels never blank during a zoom or pan.

Vessels v1.16: Fixed Offshore Installations layer (Sodir, 121 surface installations, ED50→WGS84): platforms dark blue / black (shut down, partly removed, abandoned) / outline (being installed), FPSO/FSU as hull with derrick, Hywind Tampen turbines red; names from zoom 9; tap for details; usable as ETA target. Hidden when the installation transmits AIS under its own name within 2 km (fresh ≤30 min). AIS rigs now a dark red platform symbol (grey when stale). Requires AIS Worker 1.10 (/fixed.json).
